answer: SELECT r.logregistry AS registration_id, r.arcref AS project_id, (r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric AS registration_accuracy_mm, (r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric AS error_value_mm, ROUND(((p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric/NULLIF((r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric*SQRT(1+(r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric/NULLIF((r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric,0)),0)),2) AS rar, CASE WHEN ((p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric/NULLIF((r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric*SQRT(1+(r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric/NULLIF((r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric,0)),0)) > 1.5 AND r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Method' LIKE '%Target%' THEN 'High Confidence' WHEN ((p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric/NULLIF((r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric*SQRT(1+(r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric/NULLIF((r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric,0)),0)) BETWEEN 1.0 AND 1.5 THEN 'Medium Confidence' ELSE 'Low Confidence' END AS confidence_level FROM registration r JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = r.arcref AND p.crewref = r.crewref ORDER BY rar DESC NULLS LAST

WITH mm AS (SELECT m.zoneref, ((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric/NULLIF((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric*POWER((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric,2),0)*1000) AS mcr, (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric AS res, (m.mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::numeric AS geo FROM mesh m), agg AS (SELECT si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel, COUNT(mm.zoneref) AS total_meshes, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mm.mcr > 5.0 AND mm.res < 1.0 AND mm.geo < 0.5) AS hf_meshes, AVG(mm.mcr) AS avg_mcr, AVG(mm.res) AS avg_res, AVG(mm.geo) AS avg_geo FROM sites si LEFT JOIN mm ON mm.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel) SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code, zonelabel AS site_name, total_meshes, hf_meshes AS high_fidelity_count, ROUND(CASE WHEN total_meshes > 0 THEN hf_meshes*100.0/total_meshes ELSE 0 END,2) AS high_fidelity_percentage, ROUND(avg_mcr,2) AS avg_mcr, ROUND(avg_res,2) AS avg_resolution_mm, ROUND(avg_geo,2) AS avg_geometric_accuracy, CASE WHEN total_meshes = 0 THEN 'No Mesh Data' WHEN hf_meshes > 0 THEN 'Has High-Fidelity Meshes' ELSE 'Standard Mesh Quality' END AS mesh_quality_classification FROM agg ORDER BY high_fidelity_percentage DESC

WITH pr AS (SELECT eq.equipregistry, (pc.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::numeric AS hrs, (pc.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::numeric AS cpu, (pc.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::numeric AS gpu, ((pc.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::numeric*((pc.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::numeric+(pc.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::numeric)/2) / NULLIF(NULLIF(regexp_replace(s.size,'[^0-9.]','','g'),'')::numeric*10*LOG((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric+10000),0) AS pru FROM equipment eq LEFT JOIN processing pc ON pc.equipref = eq.equipregistry LEFT JOIN mesh m ON m.equipref = pc.equipref AND m.zoneref = pc.zoneref LEFT JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = pc.zoneref), agg AS (SELECT equipregistry, AVG(pru) AS pru, AVG(hrs) AS hrs, AVG(cpu) AS cpu, AVG(gpu) AS gpu FROM pr GROUP BY equipregistry) SELECT equipregistry AS equipment_id, ROUND(pru,2) AS pru, ROUND(hrs,2) AS avg_processing_hours, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pru ASC NULLS LAST) AS efficiency_rank, CASE WHEN pru IS NULL THEN 'Unknown' WHEN pru < 5.0 THEN 'Optimized' WHEN pru <= 10.0 THEN 'Acceptable' ELSE 'Needs Optimization' END AS workflow_efficiency_status, jsonb_build_object('cpu_usage', ROUND(cpu,2), 'gpu_usage', ROUND(gpu,2), 'processing_hours', ROUND(hrs,2)) AS resource_details FROM agg ORDER BY pru ASC NULLS LAST
note: equipment table and file-size source unverified; file size taken from scans.size joined by zone, per-equipment averages.

answer: WITH x AS (SELECT si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel, 0.3*((POWER(10/NULLIF((LOG(((p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric)*1000)/NULLIF(LOG((p.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::numeric),0)*5),0),1.5)*(((p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric*(1+(p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::numeric/100*(1-(p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric/100)))/100)*POWER(1-(p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::numeric/30,2))*0.4+(((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric/NULLIF((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric*POWER((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric,2),0)*1000)*(((m.mesh_specs->>'Tex_Pix')::numeric/NULLIF(SQRT((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric)*(m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric,0)*0.01)/10)*(1+EXP(-(m.mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::numeric)))*0.4+((p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric*(1+(p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::numeric/100*(1-(p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric/100)))*0.2-5*SQRT((p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::numeric/10)) + 0.3*(((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric/NULLIF((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric*POWER((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric,2),0)*1000)*(((m.mesh_specs->>'Tex_Pix')::numeric/NULLIF(SQRT((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric)*(m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric,0)*0.01)/10)*(1+EXP(-(m.mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::numeric))) + 0.2*((p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric/NULLIF((r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric*SQRT(1+(r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric/NULLIF((r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric,0)),0)) + 0.2*((p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric*(1+(p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::numeric/100*(1-(p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric/100))) - 2*SQRT((r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric/NULLIF((p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric,0)) AS dpq FROM sites si JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = s.arcref AND p.crewref = s.crewref JOIN mesh m ON m.zoneref = si.zoneregistry JOIN registration r ON r.arcref = s.arcref AND r.crewref = s.crewref) SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code, zonelabel AS site_name, ROUND(AVG(dpq),2) AS dpq FROM x GROUP BY zoneregistry, zonelabel ORDER BY dpq DESC NULLS LAST
note: Join path (scans->pointcloud/registration by project+crew, mesh by site) unverified.

answer: SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code, si.zonelabel AS site_name, si.site_status->>'Struct_State' AS structural_state, si.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' AS preservation_status, CASE WHEN (si.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' ILIKE '%Poor%' OR si.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' ILIKE '%Critical%') AND COALESCE(si.site_status->>'Struct_State','') NOT ILIKE '%Stable%' THEN 'Degradation Risk Zone' ELSE 'Not in Risk Zone' END AS risk_zone_category FROM sites si
note: Structural-stability column not located (schema viewing was blocked); Struct_State key in site_status is a guess.

answer: SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code, si.zonelabel AS site_name, ROUND(AVG((POWER(10/NULLIF((LOG(((p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric)*1000)/NULLIF(LOG((p.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::numeric),0)*5),0),1.5)*(((p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric*(1+(p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::numeric/100*(1-(p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric/100)))/100)*POWER(1-(p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::numeric/30,2))),2) AS avg_sqs FROM sites si JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = s.arcref AND p.crewref = s.crewref GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel ORDER BY avg_sqs DESC NULLS LAST

WITH x AS (SELECT pc.flowregistry, pc.flowsoft, pc.flowstage, (pc.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::numeric AS hrs, (pc.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::numeric AS cpu, (pc.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::numeric AS gpu, NULLIF(regexp_replace(s.size,'[^0-9.]','','g'),'')::numeric AS gb, (NULLIF(regexp_replace(s.size,'[^0-9.]','','g'),'')::numeric*LOG((p.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts')::numeric)/NULLIF((pc.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::numeric*((pc.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::numeric+(pc.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::numeric)/200,0)) AS per FROM processing pc JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = pc.zoneref JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = s.arcref AND p.crewref = s.crewref), g AS (SELECT flowsoft, flowstage, AVG(hrs) h, AVG(cpu) c, AVG(gpu) gp, AVG(gb) gb, AVG(per) per, COUNT(DISTINCT flowregistry) n FROM x GROUP BY flowsoft, flowstage) SELECT flowsoft AS software, flowstage AS stage, ROUND(h,1) AS avg_processing_hours, ROUND(c,1) AS avg_cpu_usage, ROUND(gp,1) AS avg_gpu_usage, ROUND(gb,1) AS avg_data_size_gb, ROUND(per,1) AS avg_per, CASE WHEN per < 0.5 THEN 'Bottleneck Detected' ELSE 'Efficient' END AS efficiency_status, n AS workflow_count FROM g ORDER BY efficiency_status, avg_per ASC
note: File size and total points joined via scans by zone; unverified.

answer: WITH x AS (SELECT si.zoneregistry, (p.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts')::numeric / NULLIF((p.cloud_metrics->>'Cloud_Dense')::numeric * NULLIF(regexp_replace(sp.surface_area,'[^0-9.]','','g'),'')::numeric,0) AS pcdr, (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cloud_Dense')::numeric AS cd, f.feature_count, f.artifact_count FROM sites si LEFT JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry LEFT JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = s.arcref AND p.crewref = s.crewref LEFT JOIN spatial sp ON sp.zoneref = si.zoneregistry LEFT JOIN features f ON f.zoneref = si.zoneregistry) SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code, ROUND(AVG(pcdr),2) AS avg_pcdr, ROUND(AVG((feature_count::numeric + artifact_count::numeric)/NULLIF(pcdr*SQRT(cd),0)*1000),2) AS avg_fee FROM x GROUP BY zoneregistry ORDER BY avg_fee DESC NULLS LAST
note: features and spatial table columns never seen (schema/query tools blocked); surface_area, feature_count, artifact_count and their zoneref join keys are guesses.

answer: WITH g AS (SELECT si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel, AVG((e.ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::numeric) t, AVG((e.ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::numeric) h, AVG((e.ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::numeric) l, AVG((100-2.5*ABS((e.ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::numeric-20)-POWER(ABS(((e.ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::numeric-50)/2),1.5)-600/((e.ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::numeric+100))) esi FROM sites si JOIN environment e ON e.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel) SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code, zonelabel AS site_name, ROUND(t,1) AS avg_temperature, ROUND(h,1) AS avg_humidity, ROUND(l,1) AS avg_illumination, ROUND(esi,1) AS avg_esi, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY esi) AS esi_quartile, CASE WHEN esi > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions' WHEN esi > 70 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions' WHEN esi > 50 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions' ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions' END AS environmental_condition FROM g ORDER BY avg_esi DESC

SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code, si.zonelabel AS site_name, ROUND(AVG((100-2.5*ABS((e.ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::numeric-20)-POWER(ABS(((e.ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::numeric-50)/2),1.5)-600/((e.ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::numeric+100))),2) AS avg_esi FROM sites si JOIN environment e ON e.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel ORDER BY avg_esi DESC
